name: GET /api/fda/status - FDA data service availability
description: For every signed-in member: whether the fda-data service and its database answer right now (checked live through the service /ready route, never cached), the FDA data-as-of date when it does, and the check latency. Always 200: an outage is reported as available=false, never as an error. Covers: an FDA service outage returns a clear retryable error to the user instead of a server error; the fda-data service and its database are deployed independently of the main app (its readiness is visible from the app). Since the F1.5 cutover (ADR-017) the app answers from the fda-data service through @medexregai/fda-sdk; the local run needs that service up (cd services/fda-data && npm run dev:local).

testCases.name: Member checks FDA data service availability
